title: A notes app on sqlite
description:
A command-line notes app that keeps its notes, tags and search in a SQLite database.

```
> add "Buy milk" #shopping
note 1 added
> add "Call the dentist" #health #today
note 2 added
> tag today
2  Call the dentist  [health, today]
> find milk
1  Buy milk  [shopping]
> done 1
```
hints: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ...` makes `setup` safe to run every time; `cursor.lastrowid` gives the new note's id for its tags (lesson 8.05).
`shlex.split(line)` splits the command line while keeping quoted text together.

For `find`, `WHERE text LIKE ?` with the parameter `f"%{word}%"` matches notes that contain the word (`%` stands for any text). For `tag`, two simple queries are enough: `SELECT note_id FROM tags WHERE tag = ?` for the matching notes, then, for each id, its text and `SELECT tag FROM tags WHERE note_id = ? ORDER BY tag` for the list of tags.
requirements: Tables `notes(id, text, done, created)` and `tags(note_id, tag)`, created if missing.
Every query uses `?` placeholders; adding a note and its tags is one transaction.
Commands `add`, `list`, `tag`, `find`, `done` and `quit`; a database file name from the command line, `:memory:` by default.
stretch: Package it with a `pyproject.toml` and a `notes` command (lesson 8.06).
